name: Texas Disposal Systems
summary: Roll-off dumpsters in College Station, Bryan, Wellborn, Millican, Kurten, Snook, and parts of Navasota and Caldwell. The College Station page says the price is customized. No dollar rate is published.
accepted: Most common household and construction debris, including furniture, appliances with Freon removed, lumber, drywall, roofing shingles, concrete, rock, dirt, brush, and general household junk.
prohibited: Hazardous waste, paint, motor oil, gasoline, pesticides, tires, and batteries.

offers.fit: Listed as a 20-yard container. The page does not publish dimensions.
offers.shortNote: The page says pricing is customized. It describes delivery, a rental period, a weight allowance, and pickup, without dollar amounts.
offers.note: College Station roll-off page lists 20, 30, and 40 yard containers and says pricing depends on size, debris, weight, duration, and location. No dollar price, included days, included tons, or overage rate is published.
offers.sourceLabel: Texas Disposal Systems College Station roll-off
